protocol.question: Does a fixed learned ranking add retrieval value beyond simple rules on later periods?
protocol.later_origin_status: Not scored by this repair workflow; prior user exposure is unknown. Not a blind-test claim.
protocol.assumed_gap: Three full date labels t-3,t-2,t-1; all training outcome dates must also be <=t-4.
protocol.availability_limitation: Retrospective final release; no historical ingestion vintages. Buffer is an assumption, not verified availability.
protocol.date_convention: Warehouse report_date labels, without timezone conversion; source timezone not independently verified.
protocol.training: Exactly the last three mature episode origins, pooled page-episodes; no shorter fallback history.
protocol.primary_population: As-of eligible pages of clients with a labelable row in the rolling training frame.
protocol.eligibility: 28 explicit available prior daily rows; I>0, C>0, finite positive impression-weighted position. Sparse/missing days are not zero-filled.
protocol.outcome_observability: 28 explicit available outcome rows with valid counts; otherwise unknown, retained in the as-of queue.
protocol.label: 9*I_prior<=10*I_outcome<=11*I_prior and 20*C_outcome<=17*C_prior
protocol.primary_reporting: Rank all eligible pages before outcome filtering. Report observed hits, unknowns, bounds; point precision only for fully observed queues.
protocol.secondary_reporting: Complete-case metrics, support >=5/20 without refitting, anonymous client contributions.
protocol.tie_policy: Descending score, stable canonical client/content key order; conditional tie ranges also reported.
protocol.hash_holdout: sha256(flyrank-fix05-v1|client_id) mod 4 == 0; excluded from all hash-arm training; descriptive.

models.preprocessing: Independent StandardScaler per model, four numeric features only; no tuning or winner selection.

protocol.rules: Training-only position bands (0,3,10,20,50,infinity); medians or pooled CTR; visibility at training median I. High prior counts/CTR rank first.
protocol.unseen_band_fallback: Global training median CTR for original rule; global pooled training CTR for pooled rules.
protocol.final_month: June 2026 is excluded, including the sample table.
protocol.inference_limits: Repeated pages and clients; no iid page confidence intervals. Few periods/clients may preclude a strong claim.
protocol.changes_from_stage2: Numeric-only features, lagged schedule, rolling fitting, different client split and as-of queues. Changes cannot be attributed solely to time splitting.
